skill.summary: Parenting co-pilot for fathers. Stay in sync with mom, know what happened while you were at work, track bonding moments, coordinate schedules. Never ask 'wha...

latestVersion.changelog:
dad-skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a "parenting co-pilot" to help fathers stay in sync with parenting routines and bonding moments.
- Provides daily briefings, schedule coordination, and personalized bonding logs.
- Tracks night shift duties and offers practical tips during overnight care.
- Suggests age-appropriate activities and injects humor with "Dad Humor Mode".
- Ensures all data is stored locally with strict privacy—no cloud sync, no external data collection.
- Syncs seamlessly with mom.skill for unified family tracking.
